name: universitas-roblox-ctf-challenge
description: Universitas Roblox SIAKAD - The Most Based Academic System Ever Created

scripts.docker:stop: docker stop roblox-challenge && docker rm roblox-challenge
scripts.docker:dev: docker run -it --rm -p 3000:3000 -v $(pwd):/app -v /app/node_modules node:18-alpine sh -c 'cd /app && npm install && npm run dev'
scripts.docker:cleanup: docker stop roblox-challenge 2>/dev/null || true && docker rm roblox-challenge 2>/dev/null || true && docker rmi universitas-roblox:latest 2>/dev/null || true
